title: Unbiased probability agrees with uniform probability
statement: For any nonnegative integer $m$ and any predicate $A$ on Boolean strings, the biased probability with parameter $1/2$ of $A$ on strings of length $m$ equals the fraction of those strings satisfying $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a predicate on Boolean strings
